adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb` `destroy` does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then immediately calls `host.destroy` without checking for `nil`. If the record doesn’t exist (nonexistent or already deleted), `host` will be `nil` and this will raise `NoMethodError` (500) instead of returning a 404 or similar not-found response.
